Privacy Policy

Last updated: October 24, 2024

info

Overview

The Ton Pao Municipality is committed to protecting your privacy. This policy outlines how we collect, use, and safeguard your information when you use the TonPao Map application and our related services.

1. Data Collection

location_on Location Data

We collect your device's location to provide location-based services, such as showing nearby Points of Interest (POIs) and routing. This data is only collected with your explicit consent.

account_circle Account Information

If you create an account to save itineraries or contribute to the map, we collect basic profile information including your name and email address.

2. Usage of Information

We use the collected data to:

  • check_circle Improve the accuracy of our municipal mapping data.
  • check_circle Personalize your experience and suggest relevant local events.
  • check_circle Analyze aggregate usage patterns to improve municipal services.

3. User Rights

You have the right to access, modify, or delete your personal data at any time. You can manage your preferences through the app settings or by contacting the municipal office directly.

For further inquiries, please contact:
privacy@tonpao.go.th
